target_blocks.parent_heading: ## Checkpoint: Material Economy, Civic Production, Supplies, Tools, and Cultural Continuity
target_blocks.text:
<!--@1.1¶1-->
**Checkpoint date:** 30 July 2026  
**Status:** Authoritative working ledger for later specification authoring  
**Scope:** Curated adopted baseline rulings through BSA-11A

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-01 — Laws and Sayings
target_blocks.text:
<!--@2¶1-->
**Adopted in full.**

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-01 — Laws and Sayings
target_blocks.text:
<!--@2¶2-->
Laws remain MEDIAN’s functional, world-facing tutorialization layer.

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-01 — Laws and Sayings
target_blocks.text:
<!--@2¶3-->
Sayings remain a separate, non-instructional form of cultural expression.

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-01 — Laws and Sayings
target_blocks.text:
<!--@2¶4-->
Existing Laws must be revalidated and, where necessary, rewritten after the v0.5 architecture and baseline decisions settle.

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-01 — Laws and Sayings
target_blocks.text:
<!--@2¶5-->
Laws teach durable truths about the world and its systems. They do not teach transient UI procedures, exact tuning values, obsolete mechanics, or instructions whose truth depends on one manifestation of the game.

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-02 — Deep Laws and Species Dialect
# BSA-02 — Deep Laws and Species Dialect
target_blocks.text:
<!--@3¶2-->
Deep Laws are stable semantic truths about MEDIAN’s world, culture, and mechanics.

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-02 — Deep Laws and Species Dialect
target_blocks.text:
<!--@3¶3-->
Each Core civilization expresses those truths through its own phrasing and spatial imagination:

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-02 — Deep Laws and Species Dialect
target_blocks.text: - **Mouse:** joining, enclosure, adjacency, passage, and life made safe through connected interiority;

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-02 — Deep Laws and Species Dialect
target_blocks.text: - **Rabbit:** company, court, frontage, assembly, and collective movement;

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-02 — Deep Laws and Species Dialect
target_blocks.text: - **Squirrel:** connection, routes, redundancy, height, and the danger of isolated nodes.

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-02 — Deep Laws and Species Dialect
target_blocks.text:
<!--@3¶5-->
Guests may interpret, translate, misunderstand, dispute, or reframe Laws for character and humor.

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-02 — Deep Laws and Species Dialect
target_blocks.text:
<!--@3¶6-->
Guest interpretations do not create separate mechanics.

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-02 — Deep Laws and Species Dialect
target_blocks.text:
<!--@3¶7-->
> Mechanical truth remains stable under phrasing variation.

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-04 — Chronicle and Citizen’s Tale
# BSA-04 — Chronicle and Citizen’s Tale
target_blocks.text:
<!--@5¶2-->
The **Chronicle** is the Colony’s selective civic history. It records founding, transformation, and only momentous events at the scale of the whole civilization.

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-04 — Chronicle and Citizen’s Tale
target_blocks.text:
<!--@5¶3-->
Every named Citizen has a **Tale**.

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-04 — Chronicle and Citizen’s Tale
target_blocks.text:
<!--@5¶4-->
A Citizen’s Tale is comprehensive but concise biography at the scale of one life. It is more detailed than the Chronicle without becoming an exhaustive transcript.

target_blocks.parent_heading: # BSA-04 — Chronicle and Citizen’s Tale
target_blocks.text:
<!--@5¶5-->
A Tale may include origin, Hearth and family, relationships, Role history, wounds, Maiming, fears, Distinctions, Keepsakes, After-names, ordinary Places and routines, aging, death, and legacy.

## Extraction contract

Separate claims only when each remains independently grounded and self-contained. Exact spans uniquely ground core assertions. Preserve coordinated subjects or effects in one atom when they share a predicate, subject, condition, or relationship
unless every split has a contiguous span containing its own subject and predicate. A subject or label alone never grounds an
imported predicate. Anchor each normalized claim in `exact_source_text`. For self-containment,
resolve pronouns and subjectless exact-text prefixes to explicit governing subjects; parent headings
may supply only necessary status or scope.
Never paraphrase, gloss, define, compare, infer, or complete implied meaning;
use `review_required` when necessary. Parent headings are context, never atoms. Every
`exact_source_text` is
a byte-for-byte contiguous target-block substring that occurs exactly once. After JSON decoding it contains actual target-block
characters, never literal backslash Unicode-escape spellings.
Repeated spans expand through nearest semicolon-free source boundary.
Include interrupting markup or split the atom.

Obey `required_disposition`, `allowed_dispositions`, and `minimum_atoms`;
`no_substantive_claim` requires empty `atoms`. Structural headings, labels, table headers,
delimiters, and document-control metadata carry no substantive atom. List-item
claims may use minimum explicit subject/status/scope/condition/connective from
indivisible-adjacent lead-in/heading for self-containment; never infer/import
unrelated/external meaning or predicates.

For each substantive table row, cover every nonempty semantic cell. Separate
independent properties, functions, effects, examples, interpretations, stages,
actions, and results. Combine cells only when one qualifies
another or the relationship is indivisible. Preserve both endpoints of
categorical mappings.
Ground each headed cell under its header; never infer a relationship between
adjacent cells. Table spans—cell or whole-row—split at authored semicolons;
none crosses one.
Copy every authored slash into the normalized claim; never replace it with a word unless the source defines that meaning.
Each independent table-cell assertion requires exact source text from its own
cell; never ground a ruling or consequence only in another cell.

Preserve provisional, historical, rejected, example, negative, conditional,
scope, ownership, and authority qualifiers. Use `review_required` instead of
guessing. Never repair source text or invent identifiers, statuses, owners, or
authorities.

## Output check

Return schema-bound JSON only after verifying exactly
`required_target_disposition_count` dispositions. Kind `atoms` requires nonempty
`atoms`; all other kinds require empty `atoms`. Every atom needs supplied source/target block IDs, an
allowed stream, exact source text, concise normalized claim, and source-faithful
claim kind. Derive each proposal ID from target block ID plus local atom ordinal;
proposal IDs must remain source-unique.
